rationale: The single prior blocking finding CR-001 is resolved: the project_created log line at project_service.py:209 now has the space after the colon and matches baseline 1d7e4d3d3, and the test pins the 'project_created: project=' prefix. No new findings were discovered (targeted check only); business_review and standards_review are carried forward from the final round.

standards_review.notes: 3 subjects in diff_base..HEAD all match the documented 'EPMCDME-####: Description' format

changes in code_repositories.py and project_service.py stay within each module's core responsibility (get_application, create_project); no untyped new public functions, no new source files needing license headers; guide has no rule broken

get_application now excludes cli_analytics_enabled for non-viewers via cli_analytics_policy; create_project refreshes the in-request User snapshot after the admin grant; no logged secrets, no lossy input parsing, no new auth bypass observed

findings.title: project_created log line lost its space after the colon
findings.problem: The audit log line was edited in the same hunk as the user-snapshot sync and now reads 'project_created:project=...' instead of the documented 'project_created: project=<name>, by=<actor_id>' (spec 2026-08-04-epmcdme-13904; siblings project_updated and project_deleted keep the space). The only test checks the bare substring 'project_created', so the change is unpinned.
findings.impact: Log parsers, alerts or dashboards matching 'project_created: project=' silently stop matching the project-creation audit event. Unrelated to the CLI analytics fix, so almost certainly accidental.
findings.recommendation: Restore the documented format: logger.info(f"project_created: project={validated_name!r}, by={user.id}, domain=project_management"). Optionally tighten the existing test to assert the prefix 'project_created: project='.

finding_status.notes: project_service.py:209 now reads 'project_created: project=...' and is textually identical to baseline 1d7e4d3d3 line 197; test_project_service.py asserts startswith('project_created: project=').
